title: Client Booking Flow Success
description: Verify that a client can successfully browse services, select a Master, choose date and time from available slots, add optional notes, and complete booking.

steps.description: Login as a valid Client user.
Browse services by category.
Select a service and choose a Master from the list.
Choose a date and time slot that is available.
Add optional notes for the appointment.
Submit booking and confirm the appointment.
Booking is persisted with correct data and confirmed successfully.
Client receives booking confirmation within the app.

title: Booking Flow with Unavailable Time Slot
description: Ensure booking cannot be completed if the selected Master is not available at the chosen time slot.

steps.description: Login as Client.
Attempt to book an appointment with a Master at a time slot marked unavailable.
System prevents booking and displays an appropriate error message.

title: Master Accepts Appointment Request
description: Verify that a Master receives a new appointment request and can confirm the appointment, updating the status and notifying the Client.

steps.description: Login as Master.
View new appointment request in the dashboard.
Confirm the appointment request.
Appointment status changes to confirmed.
Client receives notification of appointment confirmation.

title: Master Declines Appointment Request
description: Verify that a Master can decline an appointment and the Client is notified accordingly.

steps.description: Login as Master.
View an incoming appointment request.
Decline the appointment request.
Appointment status updates to declined.
Client receives notification about the declined appointment.

title: Master Marks Appointment as Completed
description: Verify that a Master can mark an appointment as completed and relevant data updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login as Master.
Select an active confirmed appointment.
Mark the appointment as completed.
Appointment status updates to completed.

title: Master Marks Appointment as No-Show
description: Verify that a Master can mark an appointment as no-show and that Clients are notified.

steps.description: Login as Master.
Select an upcoming appointment.
Mark the appointment as no-show.
Appointment status updates to no-show.
Client receives no-show notification.

title: Master Reschedules Appointment with Client Approval
description: Verify that a Master can initiate appointment rescheduling which requires client approval before finalizing.

steps.description: Login as Master.
Initiate reschedule request for an existing appointment.
Select a new available date and time.
Appointment status changes to 'Reschedule Pending'.
Notify the Client of the reschedule request.
Client can accept or decline the reschedule request.
Client approves the new appointment time.
Appointment updates to new scheduled time and status is confirmed.

title: Automated Appointment Reminder Notifications
description: Ensure system sends push notifications to clients 24h and 1h prior to confirmed appointments.

steps.description: Create a confirmed appointment scheduled for the future.
Trigger the appointment reminder system function.
Verify 24h reminder push notification sent to client.
Verify 1h reminder push notification sent to client.

title: Automated Aftercare Reminder Notifications
description: Verify aftercare reminder notifications are sent 24h after a completed appointment with appropriate category-specific tips.

steps.description: Complete an appointment successfully.
Trigger the aftercare reminder function 24h later.
Aftercare reminder push notification sent with correct content relevant to service category.

title: In-App Messaging Functional Test
description: Verify real-time text and image message sending between client and master with correct delivery notifications.

steps.description: Open chat between a client and a master.
Send a text message from client to master.
Master receives message instantly.
Send an image message from master to client.
Client receives image message correctly.
Push notification is sent to recipient on new message.

title: In-App Messaging Media Upload Error Handling
description: Verify that uploading unsupported or corrupt media files results in appropriate error messages and does not crash the app.

steps.description: Attempt to send unsupported media format in chat.
App displays a clear error message about unsupported file type.
Attempt to send corrupt media file.
App handles error gracefully without crashing.

title: Stripe PaymentIntent Creation Success
description: Verify creating a Stripe PaymentIntent for booking pre-authorization with valid inputs returns client secret and payment intent ID.

steps.description: Send API request to create-payment-intent with valid amount, currency, customer ID, and appointment ID.
Response returns 200 status with clientSecret and paymentIntentId.

title: Stripe PaymentIntent Creation Invalid Input
description: Verify the create-payment-intent endpoint returns 400 error when required fields are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Send create-payment-intent API request missing required 'amount' field.
API returns 400 error with appropriate validation message.
Send create-payment-intent with invalid currency code.
API returns 400 error with error details.

title: Capture Held Payment Successfully
description: Verify that the capture-payment API successfully captures a previously authorized PaymentIntent with valid payment_intent_id.

steps.description: Send capture-payment API request with valid payment_intent_id and optional amount_to_capture.
Response status 200 with success true and status indicating captured.

title: Capture Held Payment Missing Payment Intent ID
description: Verify capture-payment API returns 400 if payment_intent_id is missing.

steps.description: Send capture-payment request without payment_intent_id.
API returns 400 error.

title: Cancel Payment Hold Successfully
description: Verify cancel-payment API cancels a PaymentIntent and releases held funds correctly with valid payment_intent_id.

steps.description: Send cancel-payment API request with valid payment_intent_id.
API returns 200 success response and status indicating cancelled.

title: Low Stock Alert Triggers Correctly
description: Verify that when product stock levels fall below thresholds, low-stock-alert functions detect and notify the admins/owners.

steps.description: Simulate product stock lowering below threshold.
Trigger low-stock-alert API function.
Admins and owners receive push notification about low stock.
API returns 200 response with list of products flagged low stock.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Ensure that user roles Client, Master, and Owner are enforced across platform features and unauthorized access is prevented.

steps.description: Login as Client and attempt to access Master-only management features.
Access is denied with appropriate error or redirection.
Login as Master and attempt to access Owner-only user management.
Access is denied.
Login as Owner and verify access to all management and analytics features.
Access granted appropriately.

title: UI Theme and Responsiveness Verification
description: Verify that all primary UI components render with the 'Midnight Glass' theme, including dark mode, gradients, glassmorphic effects, and animations across supported devices and screen sizes.

steps.description: Launch app on multiple devices with varied screen sizes.
UI components render correctly with dark themes and glassmorphic styles.
All animations run smoothly with no performance degradation.
Resize or rotate device screens.
UI adapts responsively and remains usable.

title: Academy System Course Progress Tracking
description: Verify that students' course progress, lesson completion, and homework submissions are tracked accurately and visible to both students and owners.

steps.description: Login as student and access Academy courses.
Complete lessons in a course and submit homework.
Progress updates correctly in student dashboard.
Login as Owner and review student course analytics.
Owner views accurate progress and submission data.

title: API Error Responses on Validation Failures
description: Verify critical API routes return appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages on invalid input or server errors as per OpenAPI specs.

steps.description: Send API requests with missing required fields to critical endpoints (booking, payment, messaging).
APIs return 400 with descriptive messages.
Simulate server errors and send API requests.
APIs return 500 status and informative error payloads.
